page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on the KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core processing is a relative bottleneck, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the weak category. Single-threaded gzip compression is poor, ranking in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by average ratings in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth, both cached and uncached, remains consistently in the average tier, supporting multi-threaded operations like bzip3 decompression and Redis SET operations, which also achieve average performance.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server represents a standard general-purpose resource profile. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource sharing, though the lower single-core speed suggests it is less suited for single-threaded execution paths. It is appropriate for multi-threaded workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, where parallel execution can offset the weaker single-core performance.
